ipa.financial_contracts.fx_option.FxDoubleBarrierDefinition

API endpoint for Financial Contract analytics, that returns calculations relevant to each contract type.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.fx_option.FxDoubleBarrierDefinition.

Syntax

FxDoubleBarrierDefinition(
    *,
    barrier_down: FxDoubleBarrierInfo | None = None,
    barrier_mode: BarrierMode | str = None,
    barrier_up: FxDoubleBarrierInfo | None = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
barrier_down FxDoubleBarrierInfo | None No None Barrier Information for the lower barrier
barrier_mode BarrierMode | str No None Barrier Mode of the double barrier option
barrier_up FxDoubleBarrierInfo | None No None Barrier Information for the upper barrier
